blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Molecular design is often formulated as an optimization problem over existing molecular spaces. However, molecular optimization and the discovery of structurally distinct replacement molecules represent two fundamentally different search problems. LLM-based molecular design agents typically perform the former, conducting local refinement within the neighborhood of existing structures to improve target properties through structural modifications. In contrast, the latter requires exploration of a broader chemical space to discover molecules with entirely different scaffolds while preserving the functional characteristics of reference molecules. We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery that enables models to navigate and edit within a pre-organized chemical space. MolHop organizes approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from commercial molecules into a coarse-to-fine hierarchical action space. The agent selects new exploration regions through scaffold navigation actions and adjusts candidate properties through molecular editing. The framework maintains historical trajectory memory to support long-horizon search processes. On drug molecule and commercial compound tasks, connecting Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 to the MolHop framework substantially improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. We develop MolHop-9B through agentic reinforcement learning, and MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro, while generating candidate molecules with larger scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that effective molecular discovery beyond the traditional optimization paradigm requires structured chemical and action spaces, enabling agents to explore new structural regions rather than merely refine existing molecules.
blocks.zh: 分子设计常被表述为在现有分子空间之上的优化问题. 然而,分子优化和结构差异替代分子的发现代表了两个根本不同的搜索问题. 基于LLM的分子设计剂一般执行前者,在现有结构的邻里进行局部修饰,通过结构修饰改善目标特性. 相比之下,后者要求探索更广泛的化学空间来发现具有完全不同脚手架的分子,同时保留参考分子的功能特征. 我们提出MolHop, 一个跨脚手架分子发现的代理框架, 使模型能够在预先组织的化学空间中导航和编辑。 MolHop从商业分子中组织大约160万个分子脚手架,形成粗细的分级动作空间. 该剂通过脚手架导航动作选择新的勘探区域,并通过分子编辑调整候选属性. 该框架保持历史轨迹记忆,以支持长视距搜索进程. 在药物分子和商业复合物任务方面,将Grok-4.6和DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1与MolHop框架连接起来,大大提高了它们的跨脚手架联合成功率. 我们通过代理强化学习来开发MolHop-9B,MolHop-9B超越基因基线,包括GPT-5.6-sol,Claude-5-Opus,和双子座-3.1-Pro,同时产生与参考分子具有较大脚手架差异的候选分子. 这些结果表明,超越传统优化范式的有效分子发现需要结构化的化学和行动空间,使物剂能够探索新的结构区域,而不仅仅是完善现有的分子.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Molecular discovery often starts from a reference compound that already possesses the target function. However, within the molecular discovery process, optimizing an existing molecule and finding a structurally distinct alternative molecule represent two fundamentally different search problems. Molecular optimization typically performs local editing within the neighborhood of the reference structure and optimizes specific properties. In contrast, many practical molecular discovery tasks require candidate molecules to leave the original scaffold family while maintaining multiple target properties. For example, applications including patent circumvention, restricted substance substitution, and toxicity mitigation require alternative molecules with different structures but matched multiple properties. Since a new scaffold starting point may simultaneously alter multiple physicochemical properties, the search process needs to continuously select new structural regions during long-horizon exploration and progressively recover property matching through multiple rounds of scaffold hopping and molecular editing.
blocks.zh: 分子的发现往往始于已经具有目标功能的参考化合物. 然而,在分子发现过程中,优化现有分子和寻找结构上截然不同的替代分子代表了两个根本不同的搜索问题. 分子优化一般在参考结构的附近进行局部编辑,并优化特定属性. 相比之下,许多实用分子发现任务要求候选分子在保持多个目标特性的同时离开原始的脚手架家族. 例如,包括专利规避、限制物质替代和减少毒性在内的申请需要结构不同但具有多种特性的替代分子。 由于一个新的脚手架起点可能同时改变多种物理化学特性,因此搜索过程需要在长距离探索中不断选择新的结构区域,并通过多轮脚手架购物和分子编辑逐步恢复属性匹配.

blocks.en: In recent years, language model-based molecular design agents have introduced a new paradigm for molecular optimization through tool use. Existing methods ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Li et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) primarily rely on local editing operations to iteratively optimize candidate molecules. Scaffold similarity constraints are further introduced to encourage the search process to preserve the core structure of the reference molecule. In such frameworks, scaffold hopping typically appears only as an incidental outcome of the optimization process. In contrast, cross-scaffold molecular discovery requires active exploration of broader chemical space. Therefore, scaffold hopping should be modeled as a search operation equally important as molecular editing, enabling agents to actively explore new structural regions.
blocks.zh: 近年来,基于语言模型的分子设计剂通过工具使用引入了分子优化的新范式. 现有方法(Yang等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a); Li等人, 2026b; Zhou等人, 2026)主要依靠本地编辑操作来迭代优化候选分子. 进一步引入了脚手架相似性约束,以鼓励搜索过程保留参考分子的核心结构. 在这些框架中,脚手架购物通常只是作为优化进程的附带结果出现。 相比之下,跨手工业分子的发现需要积极探索更广泛的化学空间. 因此,脚手架购物应作为搜索操作的模式,与分子编辑同样重要,使代理商能够积极探索新的结构区域.

blocks.en: We propose MolHop, an agentic framework for cross-scaffold molecular discovery. As shown in Figure 1 , MolHop models scaffold hopping as a navigation problem in a hierarchical chemical space and integrates scaffold selection, molecular editing, and trajectory memory into a unified agent harness. We extract approximately 1.6 million molecular scaffolds from a commercial molecular library and organize them into a multi-scale action space using a coarse-to-fine hierarchical representation. Through hierarchical navigation actions, the agent can retrieve, filter, and select new exploration regions, and subsequently optimize candidate properties through editing actions. Cross-scaffold search naturally involves multiple rounds of continuous environment interactions. Therefore, MolHop explicitly maintains trajectory memory based on environment feedback to record explored scaffolds, historical actions, and property feedback. This memory serves as an explicit search state, enabling the agent to adjust subsequent navigation and editing strategies based on historical trajectories.
blocks.zh: 我们提出MolHop, 一个跨脚手架分子发现的代理框架。 如图1所示,MolHop模型脚手架跳跃在分级化学空间中作为一个导航问题,并将脚手架选择,分子编辑,轨迹内存整合到统一的代理吊带中. 我们从一个商业分子库中提取了大约160万个分子脚手架,并利用粗对细的分级代表,将它们组织成一个多尺度的动作空间. 通过分级导航动作,代理可以检索,过滤和选择新的勘探区域,然后通过编辑动作优化候选属性. 跨脚手架搜索自然涉及多轮连续环境互动. 因此,MolHop根据环境反馈明确保持了轨迹内存,以记录被探索的脚手架,历史动作以及属性反馈. 这种内存作为一个明确的搜索状态,使代理能够根据历史轨迹调整后续的导航和编辑策略.

blocks.en: We evaluate MolHop on two tasks involving drug molecules and commercial compounds. Without additional training, directly deploying the MolHop framework with Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 improves their cross-scaffold joint success rates. Furthermore, we adopt an SFT warm-start followed by GRPO training strategy ( Guo et al., 2025 ) and train LLMs with 2B, 4B, and 9B parameter scales using multi-objective optimization rewards. The training objectives include multi-property matching, lower synthetic accessibility (SA) scores ( Ertl & Schuffenhauer, 2009 ) , and satisfying scaffold transition requirements. After agentic reinforcement learning training, MolHop-9B outperforms generative baselines including GPT-5.6-sol, Claude-5-Opus, and Gemini-3.1-Pro on drug molecule and commercial molecule tasks, while discovering candidate molecules with more substantial scaffold differences from the reference molecules. These results demonstrate that combining structured action spaces with search environments that support chemical space navigation can effectively enhance the capability of LLMs for cross-scaffold molecular discovery tasks.
blocks.zh: 我们评价MolHop的两项任务涉及药物分子和商业化合物。 没有额外的训练,直接使用Grok-4.6和DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1部署MolHop框架,提高了他们的跨手腕联合成功率. 此外,我们采用了SFT的快速启动,然后是GRPO培训战略(Guo等人,2025年),并采用多目标优化奖励,用2B、4B和9B参数尺度培训法学硕士。 培训目标包括多财产匹配、较低的合成无障碍(SA)分数(Ertl & Schuffenhauer,2009年)以及满足脚手架过渡要求。 经过剂加固学习训练,MolHop-9B超越了基因基线,包括GPT-5.6-sol,Claude-5-Opus,和双子座3.1-Pro关于药物分子和商业分子任务,同时发现与参考分子具有较实质性脚手架差异的候选分子. 这些结果表明,将结构化的动作空间与支持化学空间导航的搜索环境相结合,可以有效地增强LLMs执行跨脚手架分子发现任务的能力.

blocks.en: Our main contributions are as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: 1. Hierarchical scaffold action space. We organize approximately 1.6 million commercial molecular scaffolds into a multi-scale space and introduce explicit scaffold navigation actions, enabling agents to perform cross-scaffold search. 2. MolHop harness for long-horizon chemical space exploration. We integrate scaffold navigation, molecular editing, and trajectory memory into a unified environment to support long-trajectory, multi-turn molecular design processes. 3. Agentic reinforcement learning for cross-scaffold discovery. We train MolHop agents with multi-objective rewards, enabling them to coordinate scaffold selection and molecular editing under cross-scaffold constraints.
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 分级脚手架动作空间. 我们组织大约160万个商业分子脚手架进入一个多尺度的空间,引入明确的脚手架导航动作,使特工能够进行跨脚手架搜索. 2. MolHop 用于长视化学空间探索。 我们把脚手架导航,分子编辑,轨迹记忆整合到一个统一的环境下,支持长轨,多圆的分子设计过程. 3. 为跨脚手架发现而进行代理强化学习。 我们训练MolHop的代理 具有多重目标奖励, 使他们能够协调脚手架的选择和分子编辑 在交叉脚手架的限制。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Goal-directed molecular search and LLM-based molecular agents
blocks.zh: 2.1 目标分子搜索和LLM分子剂

blocks.en: Goal-directed molecular design has traditionally been formulated as an optimization problem under property feedback. Early approaches optimize molecular generation policies through reinforcement learning or evolutionary search, where candidate molecules are iteratively generated and evaluated according to predefined objectives ( Olivecrona et al., 2017 ; Jensen, 2019 ) . Subsequent benchmarks and methods improve optimization efficiency through better molecular representations, sampling strategies, and generation policies ( Brown et al., 2019 ; Gao et al., 2022 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Lee et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 以目标为方向的分子设计传统上是在属性反馈下作为一个优化问题制定的. 早期方法通过强化学习或进化搜索来优化分子生成政策,其中候选分子按照预先确定的目标进行迭代生成和评价(Olivecrona等人,2017年;Jensen,2019年). 随后的基准和方法通过更好的分子表达,取样策略,以及生成政策,提高了优化效率(Brown等人,2019年;Gao等人,2022年;Kim等人,2024年;Lee等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: Recent advances in large language models have introduced agentic workflows for molecular design, enabling iterative interaction with molecular editing tools and property evaluation environments. Existing molecular agents typically refine candidate structures through sequential editing actions, where the search process is guided by property feedback ( Yang et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 大语言模型的近期进步为分子设计引入了代理工作流程,使得能够与分子编辑工具和属性评价环境进行迭代互动. 现有的分子剂通常通过顺序编辑行动来完善候选结构,其中搜索过程以财产反馈为指导(Yang等人,2025年;Li等人,2026年a; 周等人,2026年 ).

blocks.en: Despite these advances, most existing approaches focus on local structural refinement around an initial molecule. The search trajectory is primarily composed of molecular edits, while transitions between distant scaffold regions are not explicitly modeled as search decisions. However, many practical discovery scenarios, including scaffold replacement and alternative molecule identification, require deliberate exploration of chemically distinct regions while maintaining target properties. MolHop addresses this limitation by introducing scaffold navigation as an explicit action, allowing agents to perform long-range chemical space exploration before local molecular optimization.
blocks.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展,但现有的大多数方法都侧重于围绕初始分子进行局部结构改进。 搜索轨迹主要由分子编辑组成,而遥远脚手架区域之间的过渡则没有明确作为搜索决定的模式. 然而,许多实际发现情景,包括脚手架替换和替代分子识别,都需要在保持目标特性的同时,对化学特征不同的区域进行有意探索. MolHop通过引入脚手架导航作为明确动作来解决这一限制,允许物剂在局部分子优化前进行远程化学空间探索.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: The MolHop harness comprises three core components, hierarchical scaffold space, a structured molecular action interface, and trajectory memory. As shown in Figure 1 , the agent selects new structural regions in a hierarchical chemical space, adjusts candidate properties through editing actions, and uses feedback from historical trajectories for long-horizon search.
blocks.zh: MolHop牵引装置包括三个核心组件,分级脚手架空间,结构化分子动作界面,以及轨迹内存. 如图1所示,该剂在分级化学空间中选择新的结构区域,通过编辑动作调整候选属性,并利用历史轨迹的反馈进行长视距搜索.

blocks.en: Hierarchical Scaffold Space. MolHop formulates scaffold hopping as navigation in a hierarchical chemical space. This space organizes scaffolds at multiple levels of structural abstraction, allowing the agent to select structural regions at different granularities according to the search state. We construct the scaffold space from the Enamine Screening Collection 1 1 1 https://enamine.net/compound-collections/screening-collection and obtain approximately 1.6M valid Bemis–Murcko scaffolds. MolHop organizes these scaffolds using the H1-H7 hierarchical scaffold representation, progressively restoring connectivity topology, atom types, and bond types from ring-level structures until reaching concrete editable scaffolds, as shown in Figure 1 (b). This hierarchy provides multiscale scaffold navigation actions, with higher-level nodes supporting exploration across regions and lower-level nodes supporting fine-grained scaffold selection.
blocks.zh: 分级脚手架空间. MolHop在分级化学空间中形成脚手架跳跃作为导航. 这个空间在结构抽象的多层次组织脚手架,使代理能够根据搜索状态在不同颗粒区选择结构区域. 我们从Enamine筛选集1 1 1 https://enamine.net/compound-collections/screening-collection中建造脚手架空间,并获得约1.6M有效的Bemis-Murcko脚手架。 MolHop使用H1-H7级脚手架代表物来组织这些脚手架,逐渐恢复连接地形,原子类型,以及从环层结构到达到混凝土可编辑脚手架的债券类型,如图1(b)所示. 这种等级制提供了多种规模的脚手架导航动作,更高层次的节点支持跨区域的探索,较低层次的节点支持精细的脚手架选择.

blocks.en: In cross-scaffold tasks, MolHop records the H1 region of the reference molecule and checks the region of the candidate structure at the end of the episode to ensure that the final candidate completes the specified scaffold transition. Details of hierarchy construction and the scaffold query process are provided in Figure A1 and Appendix A.1 .
blocks.zh: 在跨脚手架任务中,MolHop记录了参考分子的H1区域,并在剧集结尾检查候选结构的区域,以确保最终候选人完成指定的脚手架过渡. 图A1和附录A.1详细介绍了等级构建和脚手架查询过程。

blocks.en: Scaffold Navigation and Molecular Editing Actions. MolHop connects scaffold navigation and molecular optimization through a structured action interface. This interface includes four action categories, scaffold navigation, molecular inspection, local editing, and search control, as shown in Table A2 . The agent selects subsequent actions based on the scaffolds, editable sites, and action constraints returned by the environment, without directly generating molecular strings for structural modification. Scaffold navigation actions act on the hierarchical scaffold space, allowing the agent to filter and select candidate regions according to structural constraints. After selecting a scaffold, the agent uses mol_edit to perform fragment editing, atom and bond editing, and ring editing, and receives the updated molecular state and property information through environment feedback. This design allows the agent to alternate between scaffold exploration and property optimization within the same exploration trajectory. Detailed action definitions are provided in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 脚手架导航和分子编辑动作. MolHop通过结构化的动作界面连接脚手架导航和分子优化. 这个界面包括四个动作类别,脚手架导航,分子检查,局部编辑,以及搜索控制,如表A2所示. 代理根据脚手架选择后续动作,可编辑网站,以及环境返回的动作约束,而无需直接生成分子字符串进行结构修改. 脚手架导航动作在等级脚手架空间上采取行动,使代理机可以根据结构限制过滤和选择候选区域. 在选择脚手架后,特工使用mol_edit进行碎片编辑,原子和债券编辑,以及环编辑,并通过环境反馈接收更新的分子状态和财产信息. 这种设计允许代理人在脚手架勘探和同一勘探轨迹内的财产优化之间交替进行. 详细的行动定义见附录A.2。

blocks.en: Trajectory Memory. Cross-scaffold search requires tracking both explored structural regions and changes in candidate properties across editing steps. MolHop treats memory as a structured search state maintained by the environment and dynamically updates it based on actual interaction events. Memory records the reference targets, current candidate state, property feedback, scaffold visit trajectory, editing history, and search budget, and is returned to the agent together with tool feedback in Figure 1 (e). Because all records originate from actual environment states, property evaluations remain consistent with their corresponding molecular states, and the agent does not need to manually maintain historical structure and property information. This design allows the agent to compare historical candidates, identify explored regions, and adjust subsequent navigation strategies during long-horizon search. Memory supports trajectory decisions within a single episode. Its update rules are controlled by the environment, which produces an agent-facing state according to the context budget. The detailed design is provided in Appendix A.3 .
blocks.zh: 轨迹记忆. 跨脚手架搜索需要跟踪所探索的结构区域以及编辑步骤中候选属性的变化. MolHop将内存视为环境维护的结构化搜索状态,并根据实际的相互作用事件动态更新. 内存记录参考对象,当前候选状态,属性反馈,脚手架访问轨迹,编辑历史,搜索预算,并连同图1(e)中的工具反馈一起返回代理. 由于所有记录都来源于实际的环境状态,财产评价仍然与其相应的分子状态保持一致,而制剂不需要手动维护历史结构和财产信息. 这种设计使得代理人能够比较历史考生,确定被探索的区域,并在长视距搜索中调整后续的导航策略. 记忆支持在单个剧集内进行轨迹决定. 其更新规则由环境控制,环境根据上下文预算产生代理化状态. 详细设计见附录A.3。

blocks.en: 4 Experiments
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: 4.1.1 Dataset

We evaluate the cross-scaffold molecular design ability of MolHop on two tasks involving drug molecules and commercial screening compounds. Given a reference molecule, the model must generate a structurally valid candidate molecule that leaves the reference scaffold family while maintaining five physicochemical properties close to their reference values and lowering the SA score. All methods use the same reference sets and evaluation protocol. Each test set contains 200 reference molecules, drawn respectively from approved synthetic small molecules in ChEMBL ( Gaulton et al., 2012 ) and the Enamine Screening Collection. Details of dataset construction and splitting are provided in Appendix B.1 .
blocks.zh: 我们评价了MolHop在涉及药物分子和商业筛选化合物的两个任务上的跨手工业分子设计能力. 鉴于参考分子,模型必须生成结构上有效的候选分子,使参考脚手架家族离开,同时保持五个物理化学特性接近其参考值,降低SA分数. 所有方法都使用相同的参考集和评价协议. 每个测试集包含200个参考分子,分别取自ChEMBL(Gauton等人,2012年)和Enamine筛选收集中批准的合成小分子. 数据集构建和分割的详细情况见附录B.1。

blocks.en: 4.1.4 Baselines and Inference Budget
blocks.zh: 4.1.4 基线和推论预算

blocks.en: We compare three categories of methods, generation baselines, general LLM agents, and MolHop agents trained through agentic RL. Generation baselines receive a reference molecule and a target description, directly generate candidate SMILES, and are then evaluated using a unified offline scoring function. Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 are connected to the MolHop harness as general LLM agents and perform multi-turn search through tool use and environment feedback without additional training. MolHop agents obtain tool-use policies through the SFT and GRPO procedure described above. We also include the method of Lee et al. (2025) as a representative oracle-driven molecular optimization method and optimize it with a budget of 10,000 oracle calls under its original settings. For agent-based methods, the main experiments use a uniform interaction budget of at most 50 assistant turns. Because generation baselines and tool-interaction methods use different search forms, this comparison reflects their final discovery ability under the complete design workflow. We also report the tool execution success rate, average interaction turns, and Efficiency to analyze the interaction costs of different methods.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了三种方法、生成基准、一般LM剂和通过代理RL培训的MolHop剂。 生成基线得到参考分子和目标描述,直接生成候选的SMILES,然后使用统一的离线评分函数进行评估. Grok-4.6和DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1作为一般LLM代理与MolHop电源连接,并通过工具使用和环境反馈进行多回合搜索,无需额外培训. MolHop剂通过上述SFT和GPRO程序获得工具使用政策. 我们还将李等人(2025年)的方法作为代表性的甲骨文驱动分子优化方法,并在其原始设置下以10,000个甲骨文呼叫的预算优化. 对于以剂为基础的方法,主要实验使用统一的互动预算,最多50个助手转弯. 由于生成基线和工具交互方法使用不同的搜索形式,这一比较反映了他们在完整设计工作流程下的最终发现能力. 我们还报告工具执行成功率、平均互动转折和效率,以分析不同方法的互动成本。

blocks.en: 4.2 Effect of MolHop Harness on Frozen LLM Agents
blocks.zh: 4.2 MolHop Harness对冷冻LLM剂的影响

blocks.en: To evaluate the effect of the MolHop harness on the molecular design ability of existing language models, we compare frozen Grok-4.6 and DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 in one-shot generation mode and with access to the MolHop harness. This comparison changes only the search environment, tool interface, and multi-turn feedback mechanism accessible to the models. As shown in Table 1 , access to the harness significantly improves joint@H1 for both models on the drug and commercial compound tasks. Grok-4.6 improves from 41.0% and 36.5% to 64.0% and 69.0%, while DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 improves from 15.5% and 17.5% to 52.5% and 60.5%. Meanwhile, both scaffold Tanimoto similarity and MCS ratio decrease among successful candidates, indicating that the success rate improvements brought by the harness are accompanied by more substantial structural transitions.
blocks.zh: 为了评价MolHop拉带对现存语言模型的分子设计能力的影响,我们用一发生成模式将冷冻的Grok-4.6和DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1与MolHop拉带的接入进行对比. 这种比较只会改变搜索环境,工具界面,以及模型可以使用的多回合反馈机制. 如表1所示,使用电源可大大改善电联@ H1用于药物和商业复合物任务的两种模型. Grok-4.6从41.0%和36.5%提高到64.0%和69.0%,而DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1则从15.5%和17.5%提高到52.5%和60.5%。 同时,在成功候选人中,脚手架田本的相似性和MCS比率都有所下降,这表明在利用这一工具提高成功率的同时,结构转型也更为实质性。

blocks.en: A further decomposition by condition is provided in Appendix C.1 . The analysis shows that the harness improvements do not come solely from improving one constraint, but instead simultaneously increase the proportions satisfying structural validity, property matching, and scaffold transition. This result indicates that a structured search environment can activate the tool-planning ability of frozen language models in cross-scaffold design.

blocks.en: 4.3 Agentic RL Enables Cross-Scaffold Molecular Design
blocks.zh: 4.3 代理 RL 启用跨脚手架 分子设计

blocks.en: Within the MolHop harness, we further train agentic policies at three scales, 2B, 4B, and 9B, and evaluate their ability in cross-scaffold molecular design. Figure C1 (a,b) shows changes in reward and validation joint@H1 during GRPO training. All three model scales obtain higher reward as training progresses and stabilize after approximately 100 optimization steps, while validation joint@H1 also improves with training.
blocks.zh: 在MolHop控制带内,我们进一步以3个尺度,2B,4B和9B来培训代理政策,并评价它们在跨脚手架分子设计方面的能力. 图C1(a,b)显示奖励和验证联合系统的变化@ 在GRPO训练期间为H1. 所有三个模型表都获得更高的奖励,因为培训在大约100个优化步骤后取得进展并稳定下来,同时验证联合@ H1也随着培训而有所改进.

blocks.en: Table 2 (a,b) compare MolHop with generation models and oracle-driven optimization methods on the two test sets. MolHop-9B achieves joint@H1 of 55.5% and 73.5% on the ChEMBL and Enamine test sets, respectively, outperforming all one-shot generation baselines and general LLM baselines. Compared with the best generation model, MolHop-9B improves by 2.0 percentage points on the drug task and 12.0 percentage points on the commercial task.
blocks.zh: 表2(a,b)比较了MolHop在两个测试集上的生成模型和甲骨文驱动优化方法. MolHop-9B在ChEMBL和Enamine测试中分别实现55.5%和73.5%的联赛@H1,超过了所有一弹产生基线和一般LLM基线。 与最佳生成模式相比,MolHop-9B在药物任务上提高了2.0个百分点,在商业任务上提高了12.0个百分点.

blocks.en: Beyond joint success rate, the scaffold similarity of candidates generated by MolHop also indicates a broader extent of structural transition. MolHop-9B has scaffold Tanimoto medians of 0.123 and 0.115 and MCS medians of 0.660 and 0.568 on ChEMBL and Enamine, respectively. Figure 2 (a,b) further shows the relationship between joint@H1 and scaffold MCS. MolHop models lie closer to the upper-left region of the plots, achieving both higher joint success rates and lower scaffold retention ratios, indicating that the policies learned through agentic RL can coordinate structural transition and property recovery.
blocks.zh: 除了联合成功率之外,MolHop产生的候选人的脚手架相似性也表明结构转型的范围更广。 MolHop-9B在ChEMBL和Enamine上分别拥有0.123和0.115的脚手架中位数和0.660和0.568的MCS中位数. 图2(a,b)进一步显示了联合体之间的关系@ H1和脚手架MCS. MolHop模型离地块左上方区域更近,既实现了较高的联合成功率,也实现了较低的脚手架保留率,这表明通过代理RL学到的政策可以协调结构过渡和财产回收.

blocks.en: We further evaluate joint success under different scaffold transition criteria from H1 to H7, as shown in Figure C2 . Under more relaxed scaffold criteria, LLM-based generation baselines show an expected increase in joint success. However, this improvement mainly reflects relaxed scaffold constraints rather than stronger scaffold hopping ability, as the scaffold MCS does not substantially decrease.
blocks.zh: 如图C2所示,我们进一步评价在从H1到H7的不同脚手架过渡标准下取得的共同成功。 在更宽松的脚手架标准下,基于LLM的生成基线显示,预期联合成功率将增加。 然而,这一改进主要反映了脚手架的放松限制,而不是更强大的脚手架购物能力,因为脚手架MCS并没有大幅降低.

blocks.en: Increasing model scale further improves the cross-scaffold joint success rate. MolHop-2B, MolHop-4B, and MolHop-9B achieve 28.5%, 48.0%, and 55.5% on ChEMBL and 33.5%, 52.5%, and 73.5% on Enamine, respectively. This improvement primarily reflects the agent’s enhanced ability to coordinate scaffold selection, property matching, and SA optimization, rather than simply increasing the magnitude of structural change.
blocks.zh: 不断扩大的模型规模进一步提高了跨行人联合成功率. MolHop-2B,MolHop-4B,以及MolHop-9B分别在ChEMBL上实现28.5%,48.0%和55.5%,在Enamine上达到33.5%,52.5%和73.5%. 这一改进主要反映了代理人协调脚手架选择、物业匹配和SA优化的能力得到提高,而不是简单地增加结构变化的规模。

blocks.en: 4.4 Agent behavior under structured action space
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 结构化动作空间下的代理行为

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows trajectory distributions across four action categories, Navigation, Scaffold Selection, Edit, and Finish, for different models. MolHop agents and general LLM agents exhibit different action allocation patterns. MolHop-2B mainly searches for candidates satisfying the constraints through scaffold navigation and selection and performs relatively few subsequent editing actions. MolHop-4B and MolHop-9B dynamically allocate their search between scaffold selection and editing, switching between exploring new structural regions and adjusting candidate properties. By comparison, general LLM agents typically continue editing-based exploration after the initial scaffold selection, with a smaller proportion of further scaffold changes. Together with the call cost analysis in Appendix C.4 , this structured action allocation allows MolHop agents to allocate their interaction budgets according to the search state and coordinate scaffold exploration with molecular optimization.
blocks.zh: 图3显示不同模型在导航、脚手架选择、编辑和完成四个行动类别的轨迹分布。 MolHop剂和一般LLM剂表现出不同的动作分配模式. MolHop-2B主要通过脚手架导航和选择来搜索满足限制的候选人,并进行相对较少的后续编辑动作. MolHop-4B和MolHop-9B在脚手架选择和编辑之间动态分配他们的搜索,在探索新的结构区域与调整候选属性之间切换. 相比之下,一般LLM剂在最初的脚手架选择后通常会继续基于编辑的探索,在进一步的脚手架改变中比例较小. 与附录C.4中的调用成本分析一起,这种结构化的动作分配使得MolHop剂能够根据搜索状态分配其交互预算,并以分子优化协调脚手架探索.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en: 4.5.1 Effect of SFT on Tool-use Ability
blocks.zh: 4.5.1 SFT对工具使用能力的影响

blocks.en: MolHop uses SFT to initialize the agent’s tool-use ability and further optimizes its cross-scaffold search policy through RL. To examine the role of SFT, we compare the interaction behavior of base models and models after SFT within the MolHop harness. Table 3 presents tool-use performance at different training stages. SFT significantly improves tool-use reliability across model scales. The Valid Episode Rate VER increases from 21.8%, 18.1%, and 4.6% to 91.1%, 97.8%, and 97.8% for the 2B, 4B, and 9B models, respectively. Meanwhile, both the Budget Overflow Rate BOR and the Invalid Tool Invocation Rate ITI decrease substantially, indicating that SFT effectively establishes the models’ understanding of the tool protocol, action parameters, and episode termination procedure.
blocks.zh: MolHop使用SFT初始化代理工具使用能力,并通过RL进一步优化其跨脚手架搜索政策. 为了审查SFT的作用,我们比较了SFT之后在MolHop带内的基础模型和模型的相互作用行为. 表3列出了不同培训阶段的工具使用绩效。 SFT大大改善了跨模型尺度的工具使用可靠性. 2B型、4B型和9B型分别从21.8%、18.1%和4.6%增至91.1%、97.8%和97.8%。 与此同时,预算过度流动率BOR和无效工具调用率IPI都大幅下降,这表明SFT有效地建立了模型对工具协议,动作参数和插曲终止程序的理解.

blocks.en: 4.5.2 Ablation of MolHop Components
blocks.zh: 4.5.2 分子分子组件的分解

blocks.en: Under the MolHop-4B setting, we separately remove molecular editing, trajectory memory, and the hierarchical scaffold library and retrain the corresponding agents to analyze the contributions of these components to cross-scaffold search.
blocks.zh: 在MolHop-4B设定下,我们分别去除分子编辑,轨迹内存,以及分级脚手架库,并重新训练相应的代理来分析这些组件对跨脚手架搜索的贡献.

blocks.en: Figure 4 (a-b) shows the effects of different components on training. The full MolHop maintains favorable optimization trends in both reward and validation joint@H1. Although the variant without the scaffold library obtains higher training reward, its validation joint@H1 decreases substantially. After removing the hierarchical scaffold library, the agent lacks an explicit scaffold navigation path and tends to optimize properties around the current structure. This change affects both scaffold transition and synthetic accessibility optimization. Molecular editing alone makes it difficult to consistently complete the target scaffold transition and to ensure that candidates satisfy the SA improvement condition during property adjustment. The continuous reward can increase through reductions in property error, but optimizing the surrogate objective does not necessarily translate into a higher joint success rate. Detailed analysis is provided in Appendix C.3 .
blocks.zh: 图4(a-b)显示不同组成部分对培训的影响。 MollHop在奖励和验证联合中保持有利的优化趋势@ H1. 虽然没有脚手架图书馆的变体获得更高的培训奖励,但其验证联合@ H1大幅减少。 在移除了分级脚手架库后,代理缺乏明确的脚手架导航路径,倾向于围绕当前结构优化属性. 这一变化既影响脚手架过渡,也影响合成无障碍优化. 单是分子编辑就难以持续完成目标脚手架的过渡,也难以确保考生在房产调整时满足SA的改善条件. 持续的奖励可以通过减少财产错误来增加,但优化代位目标并不一定会转化为更高的联合成功率. 详细分析见附录C.3。

blocks.en: As shown in Figure 4 (c,d) , performance decreases after removing editing, memory, or the scaffold library. Removing the scaffold library and memory leads to more substantial performance decreases, indicating that hierarchical scaffold space and trajectory memory play key roles in long-horizon cross-scaffold search. The improvement from the editing component is relatively small and primarily comes from further adjusting candidate properties after scaffold selection.
blocks.zh: 如图4(c,d)所示,在删除编辑,内存或脚手架库后,性能会下降. 移除脚手架库和内存导致性能更大幅度的下降,表明等级脚手架空间和轨迹内存在长视跨脚手架搜索中发挥着关键作用. 编辑部分的改进相对较小,主要来自脚手架选择后对候选属性的进一步调整.

blocks.en: 4.5.3 OOD Optimization beyond Scaffold Library Coverage
blocks.zh: 4.5.3 食 物 优化超越脚手架图书馆覆盖

blocks.en: To further evaluate whether MolHop can optimize beyond the directly accessible scaffold space, we construct a restricted scaffold library by masking the central property region of the original library. As shown in Figure 5 , the restricted library covers only a limited property region, while the OOD targets lie outside this visible space. Despite the lack of close scaffold retrieval candidates, DeepSeek + MolHop harness achieves 43.4% joint@H1 on these targets, substantially improving over scaffold retrieval alone. This result indicates that the harness enables the agent to continue property optimization through molecular editing beyond the coverage of the visible scaffold library. Detailed construction of the restricted library and full results are provided in Appendix D .
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价MolHop能否在可直接访问的脚手架空间之外优化,我们通过掩盖原始图书馆的中央属性区域来构建一个限制性脚手架库. 如图5所示,受限制的库只覆盖有限的财产区域,而OOD目标则位于这个可见空间之外. 尽管缺少紧密的脚手架检索候选人,DeepSeek + MolHop 牵引装置却实现了43.4%的联动@ H1在这些目标上,单靠脚手架检索就大有改进. 这一结果表明,这种牵引装置使代理人能够通过分子编辑继续优化属性,超出可见脚手架库的覆盖范围. 附录D提供了限制图书馆的详细建筑情况和全部结果。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This work studies cross-scaffold molecular discovery as a search problem that requires both structural exploration and property optimization. Unlike conventional molecular optimization methods that mainly perform local modifications around existing structures, scaffold hopping requires agents to identify and navigate new structural regions while recovering target properties. To address this challenge, we propose MolHop, an agentic framework that organizes molecular scaffolds into a hierarchical search space and integrates scaffold navigation, molecular editing, and trajectory memory into a unified interaction environment.
blocks.zh: 这项工作研究了跨脚手架分子的发现,将其作为一个需要结构探索和属性优化的搜索问题. 与主要围绕现有结构进行局部修饰的常规分子优化方法不同,脚手架跳跃要求代理人在恢复目标属性的同时识别和导航新的结构区域. 为了应对这一挑战,我们提出MolHop,一种将分子脚手架组织到分级搜索空间的代理框架,并将脚手架导航,分子编辑,轨迹记忆整合到一个统一的相互作用环境中.

blocks.en: Our experiments demonstrate that the MolHop harness substantially improves the cross-scaffold discovery ability of frozen LLM agents, showing that structured chemical search spaces and action interfaces can effectively support molecular exploration. Furthermore, agentic reinforcement learning enables models at different scales to learn search policies that coordinate scaffold selection and molecular editing under multi-objective constraints. These results highlight the importance of designing structured environments for molecular agents, where exploration decisions are explicitly represented rather than emerging only from local molecular transformations. We believe MolHop provides a step toward more capable molecular discovery agents that can navigate broader chemical spaces through learned interaction with structured chemical environments.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验证明,MolHop的利用大大提高了冷冻LLM剂的跨脚手架发现能力,表明结构化的化学搜索空间和行动界面能够有效支持分子探索. 此外,代理强化学习使不同尺度的模型能够学习搜索政策,在多目标限制下协调脚手架选择和分子编辑. 这些结果突出了为分子剂设计结构化环境的重要性,在这种环境中,勘探决定是明确代表的,而不是仅仅产生于局部分子转化. 我们认为,MolHop提供了向更有能力的分子发现剂迈进的一步,这些物剂可以通过与结构化环境的学习互动来导航更广泛的化学空间.

blocks.en: Appendix A Detailed Design
blocks.zh: 附录A 详细设计

blocks.en: A.1 Hierarchical Scaffold Space
blocks.zh: A.1 等级式脚手架空间

blocks.en: The scaffold space of MolHop is constructed from the Enamine Screening Collection, which contains 4,805,572 commercial molecular records. We first standardize the molecules using RDKit, including molecular parsing, SaltType filtering, and retention of the largest organic fragment in multicomponent molecules. We then extract Bemis–Murcko scaffolds, convert the results to canonical SMILES, and deduplicate them, yielding 1,811,153 unique scaffold records.
blocks.zh: MolHop的脚手架空间由Enamine筛选集构建,其中包含4,805,572个商业分子记录. 我们首先将使用RDKit的分子标准化,包括分子剖析,盐Type过滤,以及在多成分分子中保留最大的有机碎片。 然后我们取出Bemis – Murcko脚手架, 将结果转换成Cononic SMILES, 并复制它们, 产生1,811,153个独特的脚手架记录。

blocks.en: To ensure consistency between the scaffold space and the subsequent editing environment, we further filter the structural types. The search space retains single-component connected scaffolds and removes records containing bridgehead or spiro structures. There are 87,329 scaffolds containing only spiro structures, 55,729 containing only bridgehead structures, and 2,480 containing both types, resulting in a total of 145,538 excluded records. The final set contains 1,665,615 valid scaffold leaf nodes.
blocks.zh: 为了确保脚手架空间与后续编辑环境的一致性,我们进一步过滤结构类型. 搜索空间保留单元连接脚手架,并删除包含桥头或spiro结构的记录. 有87,329个脚手架只包含spiro结构,55,729个只包含桥头结构,以及2,480个包含两种类型的脚手架,因此共有145,538个排除记录. 最终集包含1,665,615个有效的脚手架叶节点.

blocks.en: For each H7 exact scaffold, MolHop generates signatures for the H1-H7 hierarchical scaffold representation according to deterministic graph abstraction rules and establishes parent–child hierarchical relationships based on shared signatures. As shown in Figure A1 (a), this hierarchy progressively restores connectivity, topological details, and chemical type information from coarse-grained ring structures, ultimately yielding a complete typed Murcko scaffold. The hierarchical representation is generated by predefined graph abstraction rules and does not rely on clustering with continuous similarity thresholds. The definitions and node counts at each level are shown in Table A1 .
blocks.zh: 对于每个H7精确的脚手架,MolHop根据决定性的图抽象规则生成H1-H7等级脚手架代表的签名,并在共享签名的基础上建立亲子等级关系. 如图A1(a)所示,这种等级逐渐恢复连接性,地形细节,以及粗糙的环状结构的化学类型信息,最终产生完整的打字的穆尔科脚手架. 分级代表由预定义的图抽象规则产生,不依赖具有连续相似性阈值的集群. 各级的定义和节点计数见表A1。

blocks.en: After the hierarchy is constructed, each H7 scaffold serves as a selectable leaf node. During search, the agent performs scaffold queries and scaffold selection based on hierarchical nodes and loads the selected H7 scaffold into the editing environment, as shown in Figure A1 (b). For cross-scaffold tasks, MolHop records the H1 region of the reference molecule and checks the region of the final candidate at the end of the episode.
blocks.zh: 分层构建后,每个H7脚手架作为可选叶节点. 在搜索过程中,代理根据等级节点执行脚手架查询和脚手架选择,并将选定的H7脚手架装入编辑环境,如图A1(b)所示. 对于跨脚手架任务,MolHop记录参考分子的H1区域,并在剧集结尾检查最终候选人的区域.

(b) Example scaffold query process, including scope selection, exact scaffold filtering, regrouping, and scaffold selection.

blocks.en: A.2 Scaffold Navigation and Molecular Editing Actions
blocks.zh: A.2 脚手架导航和分子编辑动作

blocks.en: The MolHop harness provides four groups of structured actions, including scaffold navigation, molecular inspection, local editing, and search control, with a total of 9 external actions, as shown in Table A2 . The agent selects subsequent actions based on structured information returned by the environment, including candidate categories, scaffold identifiers, editable sites, and action constraints. All actions are executed by the environment, which returns validated state feedback. The agent does not directly generate free-form SMILES to modify molecules.
blocks.zh: MolHop带提供了四组结构化动作,包括脚手架导航,分子检查,局部编辑,以及搜索控制,共有9个外部动作,如表A2所示. 代理根据环境返回的结构化信息选择后续行动,包括候选类别,脚手架标识符,可编辑网站,以及行动限制. 所有动作都由环境执行,环境返回已验证的状态反馈. 该剂不直接生成自由式SMILES来修改分子.

blocks.en: Scaffold navigation actions query and select candidate structures in the hierarchical scaffold space. nav_where returns the position of the current molecule in the H1-H7 hierarchical space and the regions available for exploration. nav_list enumerates categories, subregions, and specific scaffolds at a specified level. nav_filter applies structural constraints to H7 leaf nodes, including molecular weight, heavy-atom count, ring count, rotatable-bond count, heteroatom count, and elemental constraints. All filtering conditions apply to the same scaffold record and are evaluated jointly. The filtering results return a candidate set with stable identifiers for subsequent selection and further filtering. nav_pick loads the target scaffold using a candidate identifier and uses it as the input structure for subsequent edit actions.
blocks.zh: 脚手架导航动作查询和选择等级脚手架空间中的候选结构. nav_其中返回当前分子在H1-H7等级空间中的位置以及可供探索的区域. nav_list列出了特定级别的类别,次区域,以及特定的脚手架. nav_filter)对H7叶节点应用结构约束,包括分子重量,重原子计数,环数,可转边计数,异体计数,以及元素约束. 所有过滤条件都适用于同一脚手架记录,并进行联合评价. 过滤结果返回一个具有稳定识别符的候选人集,以便随后进行甄选和进一步过滤。 nav_pick 使用候选标识符加载目标脚手架,并将其作为后续编辑动作的输入结构.

blocks.en: Molecular inspection actions identify editable positions in the current structure. mol_show returns the corresponding site information for a specified action category, and its all mode returns counts of sites in different categories. mol_site takes a target site identifier and returns the edit types supported at that position and information on available fragments.
blocks.zh: 分子检查行动确定当前结构中可编辑的位置. mol_show 返回指定动作类的相应站点信息,以及其不同类别站点的所有模式返回计数. mol_site 获取目标站点标识符并返回该位置所支持的编辑类型以及关于可用碎片的信息。

blocks.en: The local editing action mol_edit supports three types of editing actions for fragments, atoms and bonds, and ring structures, with a total of 9 subactions, as shown in Table A3 . Each edit first undergoes environment validation, including RDKit molecular structure validity checks and a single-connected-component constraint check. Actions that pass validation generate a new molecular state and update the corresponding property feedback. Actions that fail validation return an error message, and the current state remains unchanged. Structural validity is ensured by the editing environment, and synthetic accessibility is subsequently evaluated using the SA score metric.
blocks.zh: 本地编辑动作mol_edit支持三种类型的编辑动作,用于片段,原子和债券,以及环形结构,共有9个子动作,如表A3所示. 每个编辑首先进行环境验证,包括RDKit分子结构有效性检查和单连接组件约束检查. 通过验证的动作生成新的分子状态,并更新相应的属性反馈. 无法验证的动作返回错误消息, 当前状态保持不变 。 结构有效性通过编辑环境得到保证,合成无障碍性随后使用SA分数度量评价.

blocks.en: Search control tools manage episode states. mol_undo restores historical states supported by the environment, and mol_done submits the current candidate and ends the current search process.
blocks.zh: 搜索控制工具管理插曲状态. mol_undo恢复环境支持的历史状态,mol_done提交当前候选人并结束当前搜索进程.

blocks.zh: 表A2:MolHop动作空间.

blocks.en: A.3 Trajectory Memory
blocks.zh: A.3 轨迹记忆

blocks.en: MolHop memory is constructed deterministically by the harness from environment interaction to record the search state within a single episode. Memory updates are triggered by actual execution events, including scaffold loading, molecular editing, state restoration, and property evaluation. Whenever a tool response is generated, the harness reconstructs memory from the current environment state and returns it to the agent together with the tool result.
blocks.zh: MolHop内存由来自环境交互的牵引力来决定性地构建,以记录单个插曲中的搜索状态. 内存更新由实际执行事件触发,包括脚手架加载,分子编辑,状态恢复,以及财产评价. 当生成一个工具响应时,被带会从当前环境状态重建内存,并连同工具结果一起返回到代理.

blocks.en: As shown in Figure A2 , memory organizes the search process into a set of interrelated state representations, including the current target state, scaffold retrieval trail, revision ledger, and context for deciding the next action. This structure records changes in candidate molecules across different scaffolds and revisions and associates historical actions with the corresponding property gaps.
blocks.zh: 如图A2所示,内存将搜索过程组织成一组相互关联的状态表示,包括当前的目标状态,脚手架检索线索,修订分类账,以及决定下一步行动的背景. 这种结构记录了不同脚手架上候选分子的变化,修改后将历史动作与相应的属性间隙联系起来.

blocks.en: The information recorded in memory includes the reference target, current candidate state, property feedback, evaluation status, best historical record, scaffold visitation trajectory, editing trajectory, candidate-set state, and search budget, as shown in Table A4 . Property feedback is directly bound to the corresponding molecular state, and structural identifiers distinguish different revisions to ensure consistency between historical evaluations and the current candidate state.
blocks.zh: 如表A4所示,存储器中记录的信息包括参考目标、当前候选状态、财产反馈、评价状况、最佳历史记录、脚手架访问轨迹、编辑轨迹、候选设置状态和搜索预算。 属性反馈直接与相应的分子状态结合,结构识别特征区分不同的修订,以确保历史评价与当前候选状态的一致性.

blocks.en: To accommodate a limited context window, the harness generates memory summaries according to predefined rules. By default, a state summary displays at most 10 segments of scaffold visitation records, retains the most recent 12 steps in each segment, and explicitly records the number of omitted entries. During inference, memory content in earlier tool responses can be replaced with summary placeholders, while the complete score log remains in the environment state. RL rollouts use a separate state compression process that updates candidate lists and historical entries before new observations enter the context.
blocks.zh: 为了容纳一个有限的上下文窗口,这个拉带会根据预先定义的规则生成内存摘要. 默认情况下,一个状态摘要会在脚手架访问记录的最多10个部分显示,保留每个部分最新的12个步骤,并明确记录省略条目的数量. 在推论期间,早期工具响应中的内存内容可以被摘要占位符所取代,而完整的分数日志则仍然处于环境状态. RL推出使用单独的状态压缩程序,在新观察进入上下文前更新候选名单和历史条目.

blocks.en: All memory update and summarization rules are determined by the environment and do not depend on the LLM autonomously generating historical summaries. This design ensures that the same environment state corresponds to the same memory representation and makes memory a structured episode state that can be directly used for subsequent action selection.
blocks.zh: 所有内存更新和总结规则都由环境决定,并不依赖于LLM自主生成的历史摘要. 这种设计确保了相同的环境状态对应相同的内存表现,使内存成为结构化的插曲状态,可以直接用于后续的动作选择.

blocks.en: Appendix B Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 附录B 设置

blocks.en: B.1 Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: B.1 数据集建设

blocks.en: The experimental data are constructed from ChEMBL and the Enamine Screening Collection. All experiments use a unified offline scoring function to recalculate target properties and SA scores.
blocks.zh: 实验数据由CHEMBL和Enamine筛选收集所构建. 所有实验都使用统一的离线评分功能来重新计算目标属性和SA分数.

blocks.en: The drug molecule data are obtained from records of approved synthetic small molecules in the ChEMBL database. We select molecules with max_phase=4 and exclude entries marked as withdrawn. The Approved label in ChEMBL denotes the drug status recorded in the database and does not indicate that this study revalidates marketing status in different regions.
blocks.zh: 药物分子数据来自ChEMBL数据库中核准的合成小分子的记录. 我们选择含有 max_phase=4 的分子,并排除标为撤回的条目。 在CHEMBL中批准的标签表示数据库中记录的药物状况,并不表示本研究重新确认了不同地区的营销状况.

blocks.en: The commercial compound data are obtained from the August 2026 version of the Enamine Screening Collection. All molecules are first standardized using RDKit, including removal of records with nonempty SaltType labels and retention of the largest organic fragment in multicomponent molecules. Molecular parsing, connectivity checks, and metal-element filtering are then performed, followed by deduplication based on canonical SMILES.
blocks.zh: 商用复合材料数据来自2026年8月版的伊纳明筛选收集. 所有分子首先采用RDKit实现标准化,包括去除带有非空盐Type标签的记录,以及保留多成分分子中最大的有机碎片. 然后进行分子剖析、连接检查和金属元素过滤,然后根据Canonic SMILES进行分解。

blocks.en: For reference molecules from both data sources, we apply the same structural filtering criteria. The heavy-atom count is between 10 and 50, the ring count is between 1 and 6, the absolute value of Crippen logP is at least 0.5, and TPSA is at least 10 Å². The logP and TPSA conditions ensure stability in relative-error calculations and do not define a general range of drug-likeness. The five target properties and SA scores are all recalculated using the unified implementation within the project, rather than directly using property labels provided by the database or vendor.
blocks.zh: 对于来自两个数据源的参考分子,我们采用相同的结构过滤标准. 重原子计数在10到50之间,环数在1到6之间,CrippenlogP的绝对值至少为0.5,TPSA的绝对值至少为10 Ö2. 对数P和TPSA条件确保相对误差计算的稳定,没有定义一般范围的类似药物. 五个目标属性和SA的分数都使用项目内的统一执行进行重新计算,而不是直接使用数据库或供应商提供的财产标签.

blocks.en: The test sets are first deduplicated by Bemis–Murcko scaffold and then sampled in strata based on ring count. Within each stratum, representative molecules are selected using MaxMin diversity selection with Morgan fingerprints of radius 2 and length 2048 bits. All sampling procedures use the fixed random seed 42. For ChEMBL data, candidates sharing the same scaffold are selected by prioritizing first-in-class molecules, followed by records with earlier approval dates. Duplicate molecules between the two test sets are excluded using InChIKey.
blocks.zh: 测试集首先由Bemis–Murcko脚手架复制,然后根据环数分层取样. 在每个层内,代表性分子采用MaxMin多样性选择,其半径2和长度为2048位的摩根指纹. 所有取样程序都使用42种固定随机种子。 对于ChEMBL数据,共享同一脚手架的候选人通过优先排位第一的分子来选择,然后是具有较早批准日期的记录. 两个测试组之间的重复分子被排除使用InChiKey.

blocks.en: Both SFT and RL training data exclude InChIKeys present in the test sets. SFT starting points additionally exclude the RL starting-point set. SFT and RL data sampling use random seeds 123 and 456, respectively, and the training–validation split uses random seed 42. Different molecules in the training sets may share a Murcko scaffold, but no starting molecules are identical to those in the test sets.

blocks.en: To further analyze the sources of the joint@H1 improvement brought by the MolHop harness, we count candidates satisfying structural validity, property matching with MD<1, SA improvement, and H1 transition, as shown in Tables C1 and C2 . Each individual count represents the number of candidates satisfying the corresponding condition. The three-condition intersection represents the number of candidates simultaneously satisfying structural validity, property matching, and SA improvement, without adding the scaffold transition condition. The results show that, after integration with the harness, both models produce valid outputs for the full test-set size on both test sets, while H1 transition and property matching both improve substantially. For example, on the drug tasks, the H1 transition count of DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 increases from 87 to 192, its MD<1 count increases from 107 to 183, and its joint success count increases from 31 to 105. The difference between the three-condition intersection and joint@H1 reflects the constraint imposed by scaffold transition on the final success rate. This decomposition indicates that the harness improves property optimization and also helps the agent transition between structural regions.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步分析MolHop带带来的联合@H1改进的来源,我们计算满足结构有效性、与MD<1、SA改进和H1过渡的属性匹配的候选人,如表C1和C2所示。 每个个人计数代表符合相应条件的候选人人数。 三个条件交叉代表同时满足结构有效性,属性匹配,以及SA改进的考生人数,而不增加脚手架过渡条件. 结果表明,两个模型在与机身结合后,为两个测试组的全套测试设置大小产生有效的输出,而H1过渡和财产匹配则大为改善。 例如,在毒品任务方面,DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1的H1过渡计数从87个增加到192个,其MD<1计数从107个增加到183个,其联合成功计数从31个增加到105个。 三个条件的交叉点与联合@H1的区别反映了脚手架过渡对最终成功率的制约. 这种分解表明,这种利用可以改善财产的优化,并有助于结构区域之间的代理过渡。

Most baseline successes therefore still correspond to molecular optimization rather than cross-scaffold discovery.

blocks.en: C.3 Scaffold Library Ablation Analysis
blocks.zh: C.3 脚手架图书馆分析

blocks.en: To analyze why reward and joint@H1 are inconsistent after removing the scaffold library, we diagnose the terminal candidates generated in the later stage of training by the model without the scaffold library. Specifically, we examine the final output states of 400 evaluation samples at step 150, including satisfaction of the property matching, SA improvement, and scaffold transition conditions.
blocks.zh: 分析奖励和联合的原因@ H1在移除脚手架库后出现不一致,我们诊断出模型在培训后期产生的终端候选人,而没有脚手架库. 具体地说,我们在第150步审查了400个评价样本的最终产出状态,包括财产匹配的满意程度、南非的改进和脚手架过渡条件。

blocks.en: The results show that this variant can effectively optimize the property matching objective, with 96.1% of candidates satisfying MD<1. However, terminal SA scores do not improve correspondingly, with a median SA score change of +0.393 relative to the starting point. Further analysis shows that 67.7% of candidates already satisfy the three conditions of structural validity, property matching, and H1 transition but are excluded from joint@H1 because their SA scores do not meet the requirement for strict improvement. The final joint success rate is 19.4%.
blocks.zh: 结果显示,这一变体可以有效地优化物业匹配目标,96.1%的考生满足MD<1. 然而,终端SA的分数并没有相应提高,相对于起点,SA的中位数变化为+0.393. 进一步分析表明,67.7%的候选人已经满足结构有效性、财产匹配和H1过渡三个条件,但被排除在联合项目之外@ H1因为他们的SA分数不符合严格改进的要求. 最终联合成功率为19.4%。

blocks.en: These results indicate that, after removing the scaffold library, the search process relies more on molecular editing of the current structure for optimization. This strategy has two limitations. The absence of explicit scaffold navigation reduces the model’s ability to enter distant structural regions, and some candidates cannot consistently complete the required scaffold transition. In addition, although local editing can reduce property distance, it struggles to ensure simultaneous SA improvement. Consequently, the model tends to obtain candidates with better property matching but cannot consistently coordinate the three objectives of structural transition, property matching, and synthetic accessibility.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,在移除脚手架库后,搜索过程更多地依赖于当前结构的分子编辑来优化. 这项战略有两个局限性。 没有明确的脚手架导航降低了模型进入遥远的结构区域的能力,一些候选人无法始终如一地完成所需的脚手架过渡. 此外,虽然本地编辑可以缩短地产距离,但很难保证同时SA改进. 因此,该模式倾向于获得更能匹配财产的候选人,但无法连贯一致地协调结构转型、财产匹配和合成无障碍的三项目标。

blocks.en: C.4 Harness Tool Use and Tool-Call Efficiency
blocks.zh: C.4 合理工具的使用和工具呼叫效率

blocks.en: The MolHop harness provides the agent with structured scaffold navigation, molecular editing, and search control interfaces. We further analyze the behavioral patterns and search costs of different models during tool use.
blocks.zh: MolHop带为代理提供了结构化的脚手架导航,分子编辑,以及搜索控制接口. 我们进一步分析工具使用期间不同模型的行为模式和搜索成本.

blocks.en: As shown in Table C5 , the MolHop models have lower search costs on both test sets. Compared with general LLM agents, MolHop agents typically use fewer tool calls to obtain a joint@H1-successful candidate. MolHop models of different sizes maintain high Tool Execution Success Rate values, denoted TESR, indicating that the efficiency improvement comes from more effective search decisions rather than an increase in invalid tool calls.
blocks.zh: 如表C5所示,MolHop模型在两套测试中搜索成本较低. 与一般的LLM代理相比,MolHop代理通常使用较少的工具调用来获取关节@ H1-成功候选人. 不同大小的MolHop模型保持高工具执行成功率值,表示TESR,表示效率提高来自更有效的搜索决定,而不是增加无效工具调用.

blocks.en: Figure 3 shows the trajectory distributions of different models across four action groups, Navigation, Scaffold Selection, Edit, and Finish. Overall, MolHop agents and general LLM agents exhibit different tool-use patterns. MolHop models can allocate the interaction budget among scaffold exploration, candidate selection, and structural editing based on the search state, whereas general LLM agents typically continue editing-based exploration over longer trajectories. MolHop-2B is more inclined to retrieve candidates satisfying the conditions from the scaffold space and submit early, which explains its shorter average interaction length. Larger MolHop agents incorporate more edit actions to further optimize properties.
blocks.zh: 图3显示了不同模型在导航、脚手架选择、编辑和完成四个行动组的轨迹分布。 总体而言,MolHop剂和一般LLM剂表现出不同的工具使用模式. MolHop模型可以在脚手架探索,候选选择,以及基于搜索状态的结构编辑中分配交互预算,而一般LLM代理通常会在更长的轨迹上继续基于编辑的探索. MolHop-2B更倾向于从脚手架空间检索符合条件的考生并提前提交,这解释了其平均互动长度较短的原因. 更大的MolHop代理包含更多的编辑动作,以进一步优化属性.

blocks.en: Overall, the policy learned by MolHop can use the structured action space to organize the search process and reduce redundant exploration while maintaining the structural transition and property optimization constraints.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,MolHop学到的政策可以利用结构化的动作空间来组织搜索过程,减少冗余探索,同时保持结构过渡和属性优化的制约.

blocks.en: Appendix D OOD Property Optimization beyond the Restricted Visible Scaffold Library

blocks.en: We further examine a stricter scenario in which the property distribution of target molecules lies outside the central region of the visible scaffold library, assessing whether an LLM integrated with the MolHop harness can still obtain candidates satisfying the constraints through editing. This experiment distinguishes the ability to directly retrieve suitable scaffolds from the scaffold library from the ability to continue property optimization within the harness.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查一种更严格的方案,即目标分子的属性分布位于可见脚手架图书馆中心区域之外,评估与MolHop带结合的LLM是否能够通过编辑获得满足限制条件的候选人。 这个实验区分了直接从脚手架库中取回合适的脚手架的能力和在吊带内继续财产优化的能力.

blocks.en: To construct this scenario, we define a property visibility mask, clip_mask , based on the complete scaffold library. Specifically, we calculate the 25th and 75th percentiles of each of the five properties logP, TPSA, MW, LabuteASA, and MolMR for molecules in the scaffold library and retain only H7 leaf nodes whose five properties all fall within the corresponding [p25,p75] intervals. The resulting thresholds are shown in Table D1 . After applying this mask, 287,888 leaf nodes remain in the scaffold library, accounting for 17.3% of all leaf nodes.
blocks.zh: 为了构建这个情景,我们根据完整的脚手架库定义一个属性可见度掩码,夹_mask. 具体地说,我们计算了脚手架库中分子的五个属性对数P,TPSA,MW,LabuteASA和MolMR中的每个属性的第25和第75百分位数,只保留了H7叶节点,其五个属性都属于相应的[p25,p75]间隔. 由此产生的阈值见表D1。 应用这个面具后,有287,888个叶节点留在脚手架库中,占所有叶节点的17.3%.

blocks.en: We then select a set of OOD targets from the 400 reference molecules in the ChEMBL-200 and Enamine-200 test sets. All five properties of each reference molecule fall within the above [p25,p75] box, but its nearest-neighbor match distance in the restricted scaffold library satisfies m ​ d ≥ 1 md\geq 1 . This yields 83 targets, including 58 from ChEMBL and 25 from Enamine. For each target, we retrieve the leaf node with the smallest match distance in the restricted scaffold library and treat this result as the scaffold library upper bound. Because the target definition excludes close neighbors within the library, the md values of all 83 upper-bound candidates are at least 1.009, their mean md is 2.376, and their joint@H1 values are all 0.
blocks.zh: 然后我们从ChenBL-200和Enamine-200测试集的400个参考分子中选择一组OD目标. 每个参考分子的五种属性都属于以上框[p25,p75],但其在受限脚手架库中的近邻匹配距离满足m d → 1 md\geq 1. 这产生了83个目标,包括来自ChEMBL的58个和来自Enamine的25个。 对于每个目标,我们检索到受限脚手架库中最小匹配距离的叶节点,并将这一结果作为脚手架库的上方约束. 由于目标定义排除了库内的近邻,所有83个上行考生的md值至少为1.009,其平均md值为2.376,他们的关节@ H1值均为0.

blocks.en: We then integrate DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 with the MolHop harness to search the same restricted scaffold library, with a maximum interaction budget of 100 turns. The results are shown in Table D2 . Compared with scaffold library retrieval alone, DeepSeek + harness achieves a joint@H1 of 43.4%, or 36/83, on the 83 OOD targets. Of the candidates, 90.4%, or 75/83, satisfy md<1, and the mean match distance decreases from 2.376 to 0.542. This result indicates that, when the visible scaffold library itself cannot provide candidates close to the targets, the agent can use the editing actions provided by the harness to further optimize properties on the basis of selected scaffolds and recover some joint successes.
blocks.zh: 然后我们把DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1与MolHop的吊带整合起来,以搜索相同的限制性脚手架库,最大交互预算为100转. 结果见表D2。 仅与脚手架库检索相比,DeepSeek + habel在83 OOD目标上实现了43.4%的联赛@H1,即36/83. 其中90.4%,即75/83符合md<1,平均匹配距离从2.376降至0.542. 这一结果表明,当可见脚手架库本身无法提供接近目标的候选人时,代理商可以使用杠杆提供的编辑动作,在选定的脚手架的基础上进一步优化属性,并恢复一些联合成功.

blocks.en: Figure 5 shows a two-dimensional PCA projection of the target molecules, restricted scaffold library samples, and DeepSeek + harness outputs based on the five properties. The restricted scaffold library samples cluster in a smaller central region, while the 83 targets are widely distributed outside it. DeepSeek outputs move from the visible region of the library toward the regions containing the targets. Both jointly successful and unsuccessful samples show a clear tendency to move away from the library center, indicating that the task requires the model to continue editing-based optimization beyond the property range covered by bare scaffold retrieval.
blocks.zh: 图5显示了目标分子的二维PA投影,限制性脚手架库样本,以及基于五个属性的DeepSeek+牵引输出. 受限的脚手架图书样本集聚在一个较小的中央区域,而83个目标则广泛分布在其外. DeepSeek产出从图书馆可见的区域转移到包含目标的区域。 联合成功和失败的样本都显示出远离图书馆中心的明显趋势,表明这一任务要求模型在光脚手架检索覆盖的属性范围之外继续基于编辑的优化.

blocks.en: Six recorded ChEMBL trajectories illustrate how scaffold navigation, local editing, and recovery of previously evaluated candidates interact under the joint@H1 objective. We show the complete tool-use sequence and selected molecular states for each episode. A successful MolHop-4B case highlights a local property trade-off and a subsequent return to a candidate retained in memory (Figure E1 ). A comparison from the same starting molecule shows why closer property matching alone does not ensure joint success (Figure E2 ). A MolHop-4B failure shows an unmet SA condition despite accurate matching of all five target properties (Figure E3 ). Two further baseline examples show successful submission and budget exhaustion on different tasks (Figure E4 ). Throughout, D denotes the sum of five normalized absolute property deviations, and SA/ref is the candidate SA score divided by the reference SA score. Lower values are preferred for both.
blocks.zh: 六条录制的ChEMBL轨迹说明了脚手架导航,本地编辑,以及恢复先前被评价的考生在联合@H1目标下的互动. 我们显示每集完整的工具使用序列和选定的分子状态. 一个成功的MolHop-4B案件凸显出当地财产的权衡,以及随后对留作内存的候选人的回报(图E1). 从同一个起始分子中进行比较表明,单靠更接近的属性匹配不能确保联合成功(图E2 )的原因. MolHop-4B故障显示,尽管精确匹配了所有五个目标属性(图E3 ),但仍有SA状态未得到满足. 另有两个基线实例表明,在不同任务方面,成功提交和预算耗尽(图E4)。 整个D表示5个归一化的绝对物业偏差的总和,SA/ref是候选SA分除以参考SA分. 两者都倾向于较低的数值。

blocks.en:
Figure E1: Recovery of a candidate retained in memory.
In this successful MolHop-4B trajectory, an N-to-C edit improves TPSA matching but worsens logP matching and is undone. After exploring other scaffolds, the agent reloads candidate A at turn 21 and submits it at turn 23, achieving joint success.
blocks.zh:
图E1:收回留作记忆的候选人。
在这个成功的MolHop-4B轨迹中,N到C编辑会改进TPSA匹配,但会恶化logP匹配并被取消. 在探索其他脚手架后,特工在21转弯重新装入候选人A,并在23转弯提交,取得了共同的成功.

blocks.en:
Figure E2: Comparison from the same starting molecule.
Under identical 50-turn budgets, Grok-4.6 attains a smaller property distance but ends with a higher SA than the reference and no submission. DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 submits a candidate with a lower SA and achieves joint success.
blocks.zh:
图E2:同一起始分子的比较.
在相同的50轮预算下,Grok-4.6的地产距离较小,但以比参考标准更高的SA结束,没有提交。 DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1提交候选人,成绩低于SA,并实现联合成功.

blocks.en:
Figure E3: MolHop-4B failure despite close property matching.
The agent submits its recorded best candidate at turn 28. All five relative property gaps are at most 3.04%, but SA increases from 2.427 to 3.289. The submitted candidate therefore fails the SA condition and the joint objective.
blocks.zh:
图E3: MolHop-4B尽管接近属性匹配,但仍失败.
代理商在28岁时提交了最佳候选人。 所有5个相对财产缺口最多为3.04%,但SA从2.427增加到3.289. 因此,所提名的候选人没有达到SA条件和共同目标。

blocks.en:
Figure E4: Additional baseline trajectories from different starting molecules.
Grok-4.6 explores alternative scaffolds and local edits, restores a previous candidate, and submits successfully at turn 50. DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1 exhausts its budget after an undo operation without submitting. All of its evaluated non-reference states have SA scores above the reference.
blocks.zh:
图E4:不同起始分子的补充基线轨迹.
Grok-4.6 探索替代脚手架和当地编辑,恢复先前的候选者,并成功依次提交 50. 联合国 DeepSeek-Flash-V4.1在一次取消操作后未提交预算。 其所有被评价的非参考邦的SA分数均高于参考.
